assessments.zone: Mbuji-Mayi city: all five communes (Bipemba, Dibindi, Diulu, Kanshi, Muya) and their neighbourhoods/health areas, incl. the city settlement itself
assessments.evidence: Provincial capital of Kasai-Oriental with governorate, PNC provincial commissariat and commune-level commissariats, FARDC military region presence and ANR. No armed group has held any part of the city; the 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu insurgency mostly affected surrounding provinces/territories, and urban insecurity consists of banditry, street gangs and clashes between security forces and artisanal diggers around the MIBA diamond concession, all handled by state forces (PNC, mine police, FARDC). Not verified with fresh sources in this run (web search budget exhausted, news sites blocked by egress proxy).

units.CD8201-mbuji-mayi: Mbuji-Mayi, capital of Kasai-Oriental and the DRC's diamond city, is firmly state-held and has no armed group controlling territory. Urban neighbourhoods across the five communes are policed by the PNC, with FARDC, ANR and mine police (around the MIBA concession) present. Insecurity is mainly armed banditry, street gangs and incidents between security forces and artisanal diamond diggers, none of which amounts to non-state control. Live web research was unavailable in this run, so the assessment relies on background knowledge and confidence is limited.
